subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to SharePoint file send requests

question: Should MS Teams SharePoint sends widen to organization scope only after an explicit Graph HTTP 403, while every timeout, transport failure, 5xx response, token failure, or empty recipient set aborts delivery?
rationale: Repository policy treats removed fallbacks and fail-closed behavior as compatibility-sensitive, and this choice directly trades successful delivery during Graph failures against least-privilege file access.

options.title: Approve 403-only fallback
options.body: Adopt the PR's least-privilege policy so only an explicit permission-denied response can widen the sharing link and all ambiguous failures stop delivery.

options.title: Preserve selected availability fallbacks
options.body: Define and test a narrow additional set of Graph outcomes that may safely widen access rather than failing the send.

options.title: Separate timeout and sharing policy
options.body: Land only the bounded request behavior and move the sharing-scope decision into a separately reviewed security-policy change.

recommendation.title: Approve 403-only fallback
recommendation.body: Adopt the PR's least-privilege policy so only an explicit permission-denied response can widen the sharing link and all ambiguous failures stop delivery.
